sentences.en: The bush burned with fire
sentences.pt: A sarça ardia no fogo

sentences.en: The angel of the LORD appeared in a flame of fire
sentences.pt: O anjo do Senhor lhe apareceu numa chama de fogo

sentences.en: Take off your shoes
sentences.pt: Tira os teus sapatos

sentences.en: This is holy ground
sentences.pt: Este é chão santo

sentences.en: Moses saw a bush that burned but was not consumed
sentences.pt: Moisés viu uma sarça que ardia mas não se consumia

sentences.en: God called to him out of the bush, Moses, Moses
alt: God called him out of the bush, Moses, Moses
sentences.pt: Deus o chamou do meio da sarça: Moisés, Moisés

sentences.en: Moses hid his face, for he was afraid to look at God
alt: Moses hid his face because he was afraid to look at God
sentences.pt: Moisés encobriu o rosto, porque temeu olhar para Deus

sentences.en: I AM THAT I AM
sentences.pt: EU SOU O QUE SOU

sentences.en: Say to them, I AM has sent me to you
alt: God said, I am has sent me to you
sentences.pt: Dize-lhes: EU SOU me enviou a vós

sentences.en: The rod became a serpent, and Moses fled from it
sentences.pt: A vara se tornou em cobra, e Moisés fugiu dela

sentences.en: Moses said, I am slow of speech
sentences.pt: Moisés disse: Eu sou pesado de boca

sentences.en: Aaron your brother will speak for you
sentences.pt: Arão, teu irmão, falará por ti

verse.text: The place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
verse.pt: O lugar em que tu estás é terra santa.

reading.text: Moses saw a bush that burned with fire, but it was not consumed. God called to him from the bush. God said: Take off your shoes, this is holy ground.
reading.pt: Moisés viu uma sarça que ardia em fogo, mas não se consumia. Deus o chamou do meio da sarça. Deus disse: Tira os teus sapatos, este é chão santo.
reading.q: What did God say to Moses?

dialogue.line: Moses, who sent you to us?
dialogue.pt: Moisés, quem te enviou a nós?
options: I AM has sent me to you.
The king of Egypt sent me.
dialogue.answer: I AM has sent me to you.
dialogue.answerPt: EU SOU me enviou a vós.

quiz.q: What did the rod of Moses become?
quiz.explain: Moisés lançou a vara na terra, e ela se tornou em cobra (Êxodo 4:3).

sentences.en: Let my people go
sentences.pt: Deixa ir o meu povo

sentences.en: Moses went to Egypt
sentences.pt: Moisés foi ao Egito

sentences.en: The king said no
sentences.pt: O rei disse não

sentences.en: My people will be free
sentences.pt: O meu povo será livre

sentences.en: Pharaoh said, Who is the LORD? I do not know the LORD
alt: Pharaoh said, Who is the Lord? I do not know the Lord
sentences.pt: Faraó disse: Quem é o Senhor? Eu não conheço o Senhor

sentences.en: Pharaoh hardened his heart and did not let the people go
sentences.pt: Faraó endureceu o seu coração e não deixou ir o povo

sentences.en: The water of the river turned to blood
sentences.pt: A água do rio se tornou em sangue

sentences.en: Frogs came up and covered the land of Egypt
sentences.pt: Rãs subiram e cobriram a terra do Egito

sentences.en: God sent locusts and thick darkness upon Egypt
sentences.pt: Deus enviou gafanhotos e trevas espessas sobre o Egito

sentences.en: Put the blood of the lamb on the door posts
sentences.pt: Ponde o sangue do cordeiro nas ombreiras das portas

sentences.en: When I see the blood, I will pass over you
sentences.pt: Quando eu vir o sangue, passarei por cima de vós

sentences.en: Pharaoh called Moses by night and said, Go out from my people
sentences.pt: Faraó chamou a Moisés de noite e disse: Saí do meio do meu povo

verse.text: Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Let my people go.
verse.pt: Assim diz o Senhor, Deus de Israel: Deixa ir o meu povo.

reading.text: Moses went to Pharaoh and said: Let my people go. But Pharaoh hardened his heart. So God sent frogs, locusts and darkness upon Egypt.
reading.pt: Moisés foi a Faraó e disse: Deixa ir o meu povo. Mas Faraó endureceu o seu coração. Então Deus enviou rãs, gafanhotos e trevas sobre o Egito.
reading.q: What did God send upon Egypt?

options: I am Moses. Let my people go.
dialogue.answer: I am Moses. Let my people go.
dialogue.answerPt: Eu sou Moisés. Deixa ir o meu povo.

quiz.q: What did the people put on the door posts?
quiz.explain: Puseram o sangue do cordeiro nas ombreiras das portas, e o Senhor passou por cima daquelas casas (Êxodo 12:7,13).

sentences.en: The waters were divided
sentences.pt: As águas foram divididas

sentences.en: Moses stretched out his hand
sentences.pt: Moisés estendeu a sua mão

sentences.en: The people walked on dry ground
sentences.pt: O povo andou em chão seco

sentences.en: A strong wind divided the sea
sentences.pt: Um vento forte dividiu o mar

sentences.en: The children of Israel went into the midst of the sea
sentences.pt: Os filhos de Israel entraram pelo meio do mar

sentences.en: The LORD went before them in a pillar of fire by night
alt: The Lord went before them in a pillar of fire by night
sentences.pt: O Senhor ia adiante deles, de noite, numa coluna de fogo

sentences.en: Pharaoh followed them with his chariots to the sea
sentences.pt: Faraó os seguiu com os seus carros até o mar

sentences.en: Fear not, the LORD will fight for you
alt: Fear not, the Lord will fight for you
Do not fear, the LORD will fight for you
sentences.pt: Não temais, o Senhor pelejará por vós

sentences.en: The waters were a wall on their right and on their left
sentences.pt: As águas foram como muro à sua direita e à sua esquerda

sentences.en: The sea came back and covered the Egyptians and their chariots
sentences.pt: O mar voltou e cobriu os egípcios e os seus carros

sentences.en: The Egyptians sank into the sea like a stone
alt: The Egyptians sank into the sea as a stone
sentences.pt: Os egípcios afundaram no mar como uma pedra

sentences.en: Miriam sang, He threw the horse and his rider into the sea
alt: Miriam sang, The horse and his rider he has thrown into the sea
sentences.pt: Miriã cantou: Ele lançou no mar o cavalo e o seu cavaleiro

verse.text: The LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
verse.pt: O Senhor fez retirar o mar por um forte vento oriental toda aquela noite; e o mar tornou-se em seco, e as águas foram partidas.

reading.text: The LORD went before the people in a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night. At the sea, Moses stretched out his hand. The waters were divided, and the people walked on dry ground.
reading.pt: O Senhor ia adiante do povo, de dia numa coluna de nuvem e de noite numa coluna de fogo. No mar, Moisés estendeu a mão. As águas foram divididas, e o povo andou em terra seca.
reading.q: What went before the people by night?

dialogue.line: Moses, the sea is in front of us!
dialogue.pt: Moisés, o mar está na nossa frente!

quiz.q: What happened to the Egyptians in the sea?
quiz.explain: As águas tornaram e cobriram os carros e os cavaleiros de Faraó; nem ainda um deles ficou (Êxodo 14:28).
